text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.title: Advanced Mobs Config
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.modE: Master switch for every system in Advanced Mobs.
Turn this off to disable the whole mod without removing it.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.targ: When off, mobs stop picking fights with each other.
If disabled, mobs focus entirely on other mobs.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.igno: Prevents mobs from fighting their own species.
Example: zombies will not fight other zombies.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.neut: Forces neutral mobs into the war.
Golems, wolves, and other neutrals join fights.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.disa: Passive and hostile natural spawns are both stopped.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.limi: Caps how many natural spawns happen.
The cap scales with simulation distance.
See the spawn cap setting below.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.natu: Natural Spawn Cap Per Simulation Distance
Natural spawn cap per simulation distance.
Cap = this value times the simulation distance.
Lower values mean fewer natural mobs.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.rang: 200 means mobs notice targets twice as far away.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.alli: Allied mobs stop fighting each other and share targets.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.weak: How long a cross-species alliance lasts.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.stro: How long a same-species alliance lasts.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.alli: Chance a weak alliance breaks early.
Rolled while the alliance is active.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.stro: Chance a strong alliance breaks early.
Rolled while the alliance is active.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.scal: Allow mobs to earn and spend upgrade points.
This is the progression system master switch.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.dayS: Points mobs earn from world age. 100 = normal.
Higher values make mobs grow faster over time.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.kill: Points mobs earn from kills. 100 = normal.
Higher values reward killers with faster growth.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.buyC: Chance a mob spends points when it can buy.
Together with save chance this should total 100.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.save: Chance a mob banks points instead of spending.
Together with buy chance this should total 100.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.maxU: Hard cap on purchases in one spending cycle.
Stops a single mob from looping forever while rich.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.allo: Bosses obey the same progression rules.
Turn off to keep bosses at vanilla strength growth.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.scal: Scale Mob XP Drops With Spent Points
Mobs drop more XP based on points spent.
Each full step of spent points adds a bonus.
The step size and bonus are set below.
Rewards players for killing stronger mobs.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.spen: Spent Points Per XP Bonus Step
Spent points needed for one XP bonus step.
adds one bonus step to the XP drop.
Lower values make XP grow faster.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.xpBo: XP bonus per step, in percent.
of the mob's base XP drop.
Stacks with every full step reached.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.manu: Pretend the world has run this many days.
Set -1 to use the real world age.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.upgr: How often mobs run a spending cycle.
Measured in ticks. 24000 = one in-game day.
Shorter intervals mean more frequent upgrades
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.forc: New mobs spend their starting points at once.
Applies the full spawn spending routine
instead of waiting for the first cycle.
Turn off for gentler early game mobs.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.maxS: Cap on purchases during spawn spending.
Only used when spawn spending is on.
Prevents very rich spawns from stalling
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.forc: Run spawn spending on the server thread.
Off: uses the async path when enabled,
which can be faster on big servers.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.logS: Log a summary when a mob spends on spawn.
Writes the mob, its points, and purchases
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.allo: Let mob gear use other mods' enchantments.
On: any registered enchantment can roll.
Some modded enchantments may be very strong
on mobs, so disable if balance suffers.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.abil: Master switch for mob special abilities.
Every mob can earn 5 unique abilities over its life.
Lifetime points that count as full power.
Ability access scales from 1 percent at no
points up to the cap at this many points.
Lower values unlock abilities much faster.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.boss: Boss Combat Points Per Second: Ender Dragon
Points the Ender Dragon earns per second
while it is in active combat.
Boss Combat Points Per Second: Wither
Points the Wither earns per second
while it is in active combat.
Boss Combat Points Per Second: Mob Warlord
Points the Mob Warlord earns per second
while it is in active combat.
Boss Combat Points Per Second: Warden
Points the Warden earns per second
while it is in active combat.
Boss Combat Points Per Second: Elder Guardian
Points the Elder Guardian earns per second
while it is in active combat.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.warl: Enable the Mob Warlord raid boss.
The Warlord can join high level raids.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.alwa: Always Spawn Warlord On Final Wave
Force the Warlord into every final raid wave.
Only applies to raids that meet the min level.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.warl: Chance the Warlord joins a qualifying wave.
Lowest raid level that can spawn the Warlord.
Raids below this level never get the boss.
How many minions the Warlord summons.
More minions means a harder fight.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.perf: Cuts visuals and batching for weaker machines.
Use on servers that struggle with the war.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.enab: Batch upgrade tasks to reduce tick spikes.
Spreads mob shopping over multiple ticks.
Move heavy calculations off the main thread.
Can improve tick rate on multi-core servers.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.maxC: How many upgrade jobs may run at once.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.upgr: Time budget for upgrades each cycle.
Processing pauses when the budget runs out
and resumes on the next cycle.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.targ: How long a picked target stays cached.
Higher values mean fewer target searches.
Budget for target searches each tick.
Caps the targeting system's per-tick cost.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.mobD: Delay before changed mob data is saved.
Batches rapid changes into fewer writes.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.clea: Cleanup Non Player Ground Projectiles
Periodically remove stuck projectiles.
Targets arrows and tridents in the ground
that were not shot by players.
Keeps long fights from littering the world.
Cleanup Non Player Ground Projectiles Interval Seconds
How often the projectile cleanup runs.
Measured in seconds.
Shorter intervals clean more often
but check the world more frequently.
Cleanup Non Player Ground Projectiles Min Age Ticks
Minimum age before a projectile is removed.
Measured in ticks. 60 = 3 seconds.
Fresh projectiles are never touched,
so ongoing fights keep their arrows.
Cleanup Non Player Ground Projectiles Max Per World Per Run
Max projectiles removed per world per run.
A safety cap so one cleanup pass
cannot stall the server.
Leftovers are handled on the next run.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.show: Draw lines between mobs and their targets.
Play particles when mobs level up.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.disa: Removes most particles for better FPS.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.minF: Visuals pause below this frame rate.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.maxD: How many warlord minion links are drawn at once.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.debu: Print every upgrade decision in chat.
Meant for testing only. Very spammy.
Only toggle when chasing a bug.
text.autoconfig.advancedmobs.option.excl: Entity ids that never join the mob war.
gamerule.advancedmobs.universalmobwar_ig: Mobs do not target others of their own species.
gamerule.advancedmobs.universalmobwar_ne: Neutral mobs always join the mob war.
